big: A message claims a stock will surely double in six months. A research analyst must never make such a promise. How an analyst behaves matters as much as what the report says.

lines: Never. Guaranteed returns are not allowed. A report should show fair presentation: a balanced picture, facts apart from opinions. Records of research and data must be kept for the regulator's period. And public appearances carry disclosures too.
